requirement_statement: Roadwork signs and warning devices shall be placed according to the approved temporary signage scheme.
notes: Correct placement is a geometric relation between sign position and the approved scheme; detection alone proves presence, not conformity of layout. Second regulation: REG-DM-10-07-2002.

requirement_statement: Work areas shall be delimited and pedestrians protected from the work zone.
notes: Continuity along the full boundary polyline is the requirement; single-frame detection is insufficient by construction.

requirement_statement: Workers on site shall wear helmet, high-visibility vest and safety footwear.
notes: Per-worker check. Head and feet are frequently occluded or below detector resolution at typical site standoff; the archetypal insufficient-evidence case.

requirement_statement: Utility trenches shall be protected and access to them controlled.
Warning signs shall be posted and access to restricted areas prevented.
notes: Sign legibility rather than sign presence is the legal test; requires resolution beyond the current detector.

requirement_statement: Drilling rigs shall be operated and stabilised safely.
notes: COVERAGE GAP: no drilling-rig class in the current 22-class detector vocabulary. Either extend the vocabulary or declare this requirement out of automatic scope.

requirement_statement: Excavation faces and retaining systems shall be stable.
notes: Verified from the registered point cloud (slope angle, shoring presence) rather than from RGB detection.

requirement_statement: Fall-prevention barriers shall be provided around excavations.
notes: FLAGSHIP CASE. Requires perimeter coverage, not a single positive detection.

requirement_statement: Reinforcement shall be placed in accordance with the structural drawings and specifications.
notes: HOLD POINT: irreversibly concealed by the pour. Bar count and spacing require fine GSD; second regulation REG-EN-1992.

requirement_statement: Formwork shall be structurally stable and correctly assembled.
notes: COVERAGE GAP: no formwork class in the detector vocabulary.

requirement_statement: Concrete shall be certified and placed according to the prescribed execution procedures.
notes: Document-backed; enters the graph as DocumentEvidence, not as an observation. Second regulation REG-UNI-7122-72.

requirement_statement: Aggregate size in the concrete mix shall conform to the specified grading.
Curing shall be carried out and formwork struck according to the prescribed procedure.
notes: Temporal requirement: verified over an interval, not at an instant.

requirement_statement: Fresh concrete samples shall be collected as prescribed.
Concrete cover to reinforcement shall comply with the prescribed minimum.
notes: HOLD POINT. Measurable pre-pour from registered point cloud plus rebar detection; not measurable post-pour without a covermeter.

requirement_statement: Access to the demolition zone shall be controlled and workers protected.
notes: Compound requirement: presence of the barrier AND verified absence of workers inside the zone. The absence half cannot be settled by detection alone.

requirement_statement: Structural steel components shall be produced under a conformity assessment system.
notes: Off-site; CE marking and FPC certificate.

requirement_statement: Welding processes shall conform to the specified process nomenclature and qualification.
notes: Weld quality is verified by NDT records, not by RGB imagery.

requirement_statement: Bolting assemblies shall be complete and correctly installed with the specified inspection documentation.
notes: FLAGSHIP CASE. A washer hidden behind the nut is geometrically unobservable from most viewpoints: the canonical insufficient-evidence instance. Second regulation REG-NTC-2018 Cap. 4.2.8.

requirement_statement: Hot-rolled structural steel products shall conform to the specified product standards.
Cold-formed structural steel products shall conform to the specified product standards.
Falling material shall be contained and prevented from reaching persons or property.
notes: Chutes and containment sheeting are not in the detector vocabulary; only the perimeter half is automatable.

requirement_statement: Structural bearings shall be of the specified type and correctly installed to provide the design constraint.
notes: COVERAGE GAP: no bearing class in the detector vocabulary.

requirement_statement: Structural members shall be installed in the sequence and configuration required by the design.
notes: BIM-conditioned presence check: the expected member set comes from the model, so a missing member is a verified absence problem. Second regulation REG-EN-1993.

requirement_statement: Lifting operations shall be planned and carried out safely.
regulation_clause: Titolo IV Capo I; Allegato VI
notes: COVERAGE GAP: no crane or load class in the detector vocabulary.

requirement_statement: Reinforcement and formwork shall be verified before concrete placement.
notes: HOLD POINT with an explicit temporal ordering constraint: the observation must precede the pour activity, which the phase model can enforce.

requirement_statement: The expansion joint shall prevent water ingress through the deck gap.
notes: COVERAGE GAP: no expansion-joint class in the detector vocabulary.

requirement_statement: Utilities shall be protected and reinstated in accordance with the approved relocation plans.
notes: Concealed after backfill; as-built survey is the only durable evidence. Second regulation REG-DLGS-81-2008.

requirement_statement: Pavement geometry and surface condition shall comply with the roadway design.
notes: Verified from the registered point cloud against the design surface, including the 32 cm raised profile and the 5% / 3.5% ramp slopes.

requirement_statement: Concrete surfaces subject to traffic shall be waterproofed with a reinforced bituminous sheath.
notes: HOLD POINT: concealed by the wearing course. Photographic evidence must be timestamped before surfacing.

requirement_statement: The bitumen binder shall meet the specified characteristics.
Roadside safety barriers shall be installed with the required class and without discontinuity.
notes: FLAGSHIP CASE. Continuity is a coverage predicate over the whole alignment: the requirement is unsatisfiable from evidence unless observed coverage approaches 1.

requirement_statement: Handrails and pedestrian safety barriers shall be installed.
notes: Second regulation REG-DLGS-81-2008.

inspection_item: Site restoration and removal of temporary works
requirement_statement: All temporary structures and barriers shall be removed and the site restored.
notes: FLAGSHIP CASE. A purely negative requirement: satisfied only by verified absence over the whole site, which is the hardest thing for an open-world detector to establish.
